brief:
A former Palestine Liberation Organization official has indicated that a coalition government between Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Gadi Eisenkot could emerge from upcoming elections, Al Jazeera English reported. The comment reflects uncertainty about Israel's political trajectory, with election polls currently divided between the two potential leaders.

The political landscape remains fluid, with multiple coalition scenarios possible depending on final vote tallies and post-election negotiations among parties.
dek: Former PLO official says Israel’s election outcome remains uncertain, with polls divided between Netanyahu and Eisenkot.
title: Former PLO official suggests Netanyahu-Eisenkot coalition could form
